


Small Business Economic Trends
June 2026

A Report on the NFIB Small Business Economic Trends Survey

SUMMARY

The Small Business Optimism Index rose to 98.5 in June 2026, up 2.3 points
from May. Five of the ten index components increased, three decreased,
and two were unchanged.

LABOR MARKETS
Fifty-six percent reported few or no qualified applicants for positions
they were trying to fill. Thirty-seven percent of owners reported job
openings that were hard to fill, unchanged from May. A seasonally adjusted
net 11% of owners plan to create new jobs, up 2 points from May.

CAPITAL SPENDING
Fifty-three percent reported capital outlays in the last six months, down
3 points from May. Eight percent reported capital outlays in the near
future as the single most important business problem. A net 8% of owners
expect business conditions to improve, down 1 point from May.

INVENTORIES
The net percent of owners reporting inventory gains was a net -3%,
seasonally adjusted. Inventory investment has been a drag on GDP.

SALES AND EARNINGS
The net percent of owners expecting higher real sales rose 3 points to
a net 9% of owners.

The frequency of reports of positive profit trends was a net negative
15%, unchanged from May.

CREDIT CONDITIONS
Two percent of owners reported that financing was their top business
problem. A net 4% reported loans harder to get than in the previous
period.

INFLATION
Twenty-three percent of owners reported inflation as their single most
important problem, down 1 point from May.

COMPONENT SUMMARY
Seasonally Adjusted

COMPONENT                                  CURRENT  CHANGE  DIRECTION
Small Business Optimism Index                98.5    +2.3    Up
Plans to Increase Employment                  11      +2     Up
Plans to Make Capital Expenditures             8       0     Flat
Plans to Increase Inventories                 -3      -1     Down
Expect Economy to Improve                     13      +5     Up
Expect Real Sales Higher                       9      +3     Up
Current Inventory                              -4      -2     Down
Earnings Trends                               -15      0     Flat
Job Openings                                   37     -2     Down
Credit Availability                             4       0     Flat
